title: Use the title architect only when registered
what: Use a restricted title, such as architect or registered architect, only if registered as an architect.

sources.title: Architects Act 1963 (NT)
sources.quote: An individual commits an offence if: (a) the individual intentionally takes or uses a restricted title to describe themselves or a service the individual provides; and (b) the individual is not an architect and the individual has knowledge of that circumstance

sources.title: Architects Act 1963 (NT)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: Board means the Northern Territory Architects Board constituted by this Act.
